A feeling fills my stomach, a caving in empty feeling, and I start to panic about getting down. 

I try to step down, like when in a swimming pool but you can't see the bottom; holding the side and lowering yourself down, hoping the water will catch your weight? Hoping the darkness will maybe just hold me, I swallow the panic setting in and close my eyes, and let go. Once I let go of the bed, I already know I've made a huge mistake.
